Name: Messy Crops
Author: tlitookilakin
Description:
[center][img]https://wrengrasley.com/hosted/stardew/general/about.png[/img]﻿[/center]
Messy Crops is a simple mod which slightly randomizes crop positions to give your plants a more organic look. It is a purely cosmetic mod, which does not effect the functionality or collision of crops. It applies to all crops, including ones in garden pots, but can be configured.

[center][img]https://wrengrasley.com/hosted/stardew/general/configuration.png[/img]﻿[/center]
This mod can be configured in-game using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]. (Though only on the title screen, for performance reasons.)

Messy Crops currently offers the following config options:
[list]
[*][b]Offset:[/b] Controls how much crops are moved by. Can be set to 0 to disable the mod entirely.
[*][b]Apply to Trellis:[/b] Whether or not trellis crops should also be offset. (For those who like their trellis crops in nice neat rows.)
[/list]
[center][img]https://wrengrasley.com/hosted/stardew/general/installation.png[/img][/center]
﻿Just download the zip and extract it into your Mods folder. Make sure SMAPI is installed and up-to-date.

[center][img]https://wrengrasley.com/hosted/stardew/general/more-info.png[/img][/center]
